## Description

Trade a break above/below the high/low of the first X minutes of the session.

## Where it may fit

Sessions with news-driven price discovery and sustained follow-through after the open.

## Vehicles

Liquid equity/index ETFs and futures; some FX sessions.

## Required data

Minute bars or trades, opening range, session calendar, volume, spreads, event calendar.

## Caveats

Open spreads, slippage, limit-up/down events and look-ahead bias in range construction are important.
